item.title: Marcos and Robredo set meeting in Naga amid flood control visit
item.description: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is scheduled to visit Naga City on February 21, where he will meet former vice president and current mayor Leni Robredo as part of the administration’s “Oplan Kontra Baha” initiative. item.description: The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Global Anti-Scam Alliance (GASA) to enhance protection for overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) and their families from online scams and digital fraud. item.title: Philippines and Oman move closer to bilateral labor deal to strengthen OFW protection
item.description: The Philippines and Oman have reaffirmed their strong labor partnership as officials from the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) met with Omani counterparts to advance a proposed bilateral labor agreement aimed at improving protection for Filipino workers. item.title: Pasig Mayor Vico Sotto files election complaint against contractor Sarah Discaya
item.description: Mayor Vico Sotto filed a complaint before the Commission on Elections (Comelec) against contractor Sarah Discaya for alleged overspending and perjury during the 2025 midterm elections. Sotto personally lodged the complaint at Comelec’s Political Finance and Affairs Department, accompanied by his election lawyer, Atty. Romulo Macalintal.
